# Breaking Muscle

> > Breaking Muscle is a comprehensive fitness media platform providing workout programs, exercise guides, and training resources for strength training, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, CrossFit, and general fitness.

Breaking Muscle serves as a community hub and educational resource for fitness enthusiasts, offering evidence-based training programs, detailed exercise tutorials, nutrition guidance, and industry news. The site caters to athletes across multiple disciplines including strength training, martial arts (particularly BJJ), and functional fitness.

## Key Topics

- Strength Training
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ)
- Workout Routines
- Exercise Guides
- Fitness Community
- Health & Nutrition
- CrossFit
- Bodybuilding
- Training Programs
- Exercise Library
- Fitness News
- Workout Tutorials
- Functional Fitness
